text:
Greta Oyelaran will be the next conductor of the Halewyn Philharmonic, the orchestra's board announced on 14 March 2025.

Tobias Verhaegen, Chair of the Halewyn Philharmonic Board, confirmed the appointment. It follows a board vote held on 13 March, and the decision was set out in an official press release titled "Appointment of Music Director," which this paper has read.

Oyelaran has signed a four-year contract and takes up the post at the start of the 2025-26 season. According to the release, 62 performances are scheduled for her first season.

The Gazette's account rests on the board's release and Verhaegen's confirmation of it. We were not present at the vote. Readers with questions about the season programme should expect further details from the orchestra in due course.
